assessment: Prototype removes shared ordinary deferred dispatch/completion and blocked-job scans, but its dual serial/parallel representation and research controls are not a minimal production design. A timing win alone does not justify shipping all cumulative+611/-228 lines. Retain frozen source until qualification and measurements.

necessary_invariants.state: Slot serial, Claim slot/index/serial, stable per-slot job storage
necessary_invariants.purpose: ABA stale handles and queued intrusive-node lifetime until join. Do not replace serial validation or free on completed count alone.

necessary_invariants.state: Per-worker queue mutex/CV/head/tail and immutable copied Dispatch
necessary_invariants.purpose: Workers obtain runnable work without shared dispatch mutex; copy callback/context/offset before execution, so no global lookup prologue.

necessary_invariants.state: Lane head/tail, laneNext and lane-local mutex
necessary_invariants.purpose: Exactly one runnable head per ordered controller lane, promotion before predecessor batch retirement. Single owner admission locks referenced lanes in stable order.

Cheap NoLane fan-in; finished is terminal-notifier publication, not merely arithmetic total. Join always acknowledges batch mutex before retirement; polling cannot bypass ack. Error protected independently.
Exactly-once early/late external settlement and safe teardown after continuation publication. Lifetime mutex serializes external API lifetime only, not ordinary callbacks.
Static assigned required jobs cannot wait behind optional callbacks while spare workers exist. Preserve even if research RR modes deleted; primary stealing can otherwise miss transient victim lock.
Peer distribution wakes must not trigger global control inspection on every job; control generations preserve run/presentation/lifecycle service and lostwake safety.

deletion_opportunities.proposal: Select one dispatch policy; remove getenv selector, laneAffinity mode and static RR research controls, their mode-specific branches and research-only counters/tests that establish no retained contract.
deletion_opportunities.keep: General steal primary plus mandatory optional rescue. Retain relevant contract regression tests.

deletion_opportunities.proposal: Make per-job record canonical at admission: immutable lane/offset/callback plus lane link/current continuation, reused for both serial and worker execution.
deletion_opportunities.current_redundancy: groups + starts + jobGroups + dispatch carry overlapping callback/lane/index mapping; continuations vector duplicates mutable callback choice; serial execute reconstructs Dispatch under global mutex.
deletion_opportunities.potential_deletions: Remove jobGroups and group helper; potentially groups/starts and continuations if Trace metadata separately preserved. This is an actual representation simplification, not just deleting assertions.
deletion_opportunities.caution: Trace uses group laneBases+starts at528-529; per-job trace sequence costs more bytes than per-group. Do not trade fewer lines for unmeasured per-job memory expansion. Continuation resume must preserve lane and offset0 while retaining old leases/context lifetime.

deletion_opportunities.proposal: Replace ready linked-batch structure with fixed-slot due scan of nonempty readyJobs for owner fallback.
deletion_opportunities.current_redundancy: readyCount/head/tail plus per-slot readyNext/readyPosition, add/remove list traversal. readyPosition is only sentinel-or0, never a position. pick owner already scans linked ready batches.
deletion_opportunities.tradeoff: Eliminates list maintenance/state and branch for unused parallel pick; scans bounded Slots only in no-worker fallback. Preserve exact due and ascending ready-index owner contract; retain minheap unless a contract audit permits simpler FIFO. No worker blocked-job scanning reintroduced.

deletion_opportunities.proposal: Rename readyPosition to membership bool if list retained; remove pick(bool owner)/claim(bool owner) nonowner branches since assert owner==ownerRunsDeferred and parallel path never calls them.
deletion_opportunities.caution: Verify complete call graph and tests before edit.

deletion_opportunities.proposal: Move laneIssued/laneBases into diagnostics state if only Trace uses sequence; retain laneDue because pending-lane due-order validation is functional.
deletion_opportunities.tradeoff: No Off sequence increments/storage solely for diagnostic ordering; ensure telemetry configure resets and no public metric dependence.

deletion_opportunities.proposal: Replace ControlWake CV-shaped wrapper with explicit wakeControl calls once source stable.
deletion_opportunities.reason: notify_one currently broadcasts control to all queues. Explicit operation expresses real semantics and avoids misleading local wake interpretation.
deletion_opportunities.caution: This changes spelling only, not scheduling; no performance claim.

not_redundant: finished cannot simply become completed==total: last notifier must still finish accessing slot mutex/CV before owner may recycle.
laneDue cannot be deleted with laneIssued: laneDue rejects enqueueing earlier-due work behind pending later-due lane head.
Ticket resolved/running/settled states encode early external completion race; do not collapse without proof.
CompletionLifetime teardown acknowledgment must cover sender notifications after continuation already completed.
optionalBusy rescue covers frozen first RR contract failure; deleting static policy alone does not prove best-effort try-steal cannot miss rescue opportunity.

residual_costs.immediate_run: run/invoke still shared work-generation/inFlight/runDone accounting; not changed by deferred redesign.
residual_costs.periodic_control: Global mutex every eight claims, control epoch, and idle maintenance/presentation inspection; wakeControl visits all queue mutexes. See control-inspection-followup.json for pending-opportunity epoch design, no current edit.
residual_costs.other_shared: Atomic dispatchCursor on every ready enqueue; same-lane mutex by design; per-batch atomic fan-in; Trace intentionally global diagnostic work. External ticket APIs globally serialized through lifetime mutex only when called.

minimal_production_scope_if_wins: One stealing policy; per-worker runnable queues, canonical ready lane heads, batch-local terminal fan-in and ticket-local settlement. Preserve existing public ComputeExecutor lifecycle and Group API; no cost-hint API required.
Retain simulation-facing lanes, publication horizons, context/maintenance/presentation affinity, slot generations and errors; preserve mandatory optional rescue and precise retirement acknowledgment.

Simplify duplicated per-job/serial representations only after frozen correctness/timing results; requalify final source. Do not simultaneously redesign immediate run/control unless profiles justify separate step.

Weighted dynamic placement is separate incremental experiment: require benefit versus bare-steal after clocks, class atomic writes/CAS, O(N) loads and cold/within-class controls. Do not add Group hints/class machinery based on standalone success alone.
acceptance: Require clear game performance benefit and correctness/save/load/per-tick evidence, then review minimal final patch for state and ownership clarity. Net lines are warning of prototype scope, not sole metric. No performance or platform coverage claim made.
